# Check: upstream overlay-options.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/overlay-options.test.ts

## Subject
TUI overlay positioning, sizing, and rendering options.

## Upstream test count (approx)
32

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- truncates overlay lines exceeding declared width
- handles complex ANSI sequences without crashing
- overlay composited on styled base content
- handles wide characters at overlay boundary
- positioned at terminal edge
- overlay on base content with OSC sequences
- renders overlay at percentage of terminal width
- respects minWidth when widthPercent results in smaller width
- positions: top-left, bottom-right, top-center
- clamps negative margins to zero
- margin as number; margin object with individual sides
- offsetX and offsetY from anchor position
- rowPercent and colPercent positioning; rowPercent 0 → top; rowPercent 100 → bottom
- truncates to maxHeight and maxHeightPercent
- row and col override anchor
- multiple overlays with later ones on top
- overlays at different positions without interference
- proper hiding in stack order

## Upstream dependencies
Component, TUI, VirtualTerminal

## Upstream notes
Options: width (number or "%" string), anchor (top-left, bottom-right, top-center, center), margin (number or object {top,left,right,bottom}), offsetX/offsetY, row/col, minWidth, maxHeight, maxHeightPercent. Percentages computed. Negative margins clamped to 0. Overlays render in creation order by default; focused overlays render on top.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/overlay_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/overlay-options.test.ts (21 tests — integration via TUI.showOverlay + viewport inspection)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/overlay_test.exs (25 tests — pure-function level on Overlay.resolve_and_clip / anchor_row / anchor_col / composite)

## MAPPED

| Upstream | Elixir |
|---|---|
| renders overlay at percentage of terminal width | "percentage width" (`{50, :percent}` on 80 → 40) |
| respects minWidth when widthPercent smaller | "min_width enforced" |
| positions at top-left | "top-left anchor with margin" (semantic coverage of anchor resolution) |
| positions at bottom-right | "bottom-right anchor" |
| clamps negative margins to zero | "negative margins clamped to zero" |
| margin as object with individual sides | "map margin with individual sides" |
| margin as number | covered by anchor tests with simple margin int |
| applies offsetX and offsetY from anchor | "offset_x and offset_y applied after positioning" |
| positions with rowPercent and colPercent | "percentage row and col" |
| truncates overlay to maxHeight | "max_height clips lines" |
| truncates overlay to maxHeightPercent | "percentage max_height" |
| row and col override anchor | "absolute row and col override anchor" |
| top-center anchor | "center anchors vertically center" + "center anchors horizontally center" (anchor_row/anchor_col describes) |

## UNMAPPED

1. **width overflow protection (6 upstream tests, 5 largely uncovered)**:
   - Truncate overlay lines that exceed declared width (overlay renders wider than width)
   - Complex ANSI sequences in overlay content do not crash
   - Overlay composited on styled base content — overlay still visible
   - Wide characters (CJK) at overlay boundary — does not crash
   - Overlay positioned at terminal edge (col 60, width 20 in 80-wide) — does not crash
   - Our coverage: `"overlay clipped to terminal width"` (base+overlay width clip) and `"OSC 8 in base content does not crash"` are related but narrower.
2. **rowPercent 0 and 100 extremes** — we test 50%, not the 0/100 edges.
3. **Integration-level stacked overlay tests (3)**:
   - showOverlay twice → top overlay covers bottom (our `"stacked overlays: higher z paints on top"` covers z-ordering at composite level, not the `showOverlay` API path).
   - Two overlays at different positions — both visible.
   - hideOverlay() pops in stack order; previously-hidden overlay becomes visible.
4. **Anchor tests that use the TUI render pipeline** (top-left, bottom-right, top-center) — our anchor tests verify the math but not the full render pipeline producing the text at those columns.

## N/A / EXTRA

Our overlay_test.exs has extensive composite_line unit tests (paints at start/middle/end, pads short base/overlay) that are not in upstream overlay-options.test.ts — retain.

## Action

Compliance ticket: add 7+ integration tests covering width overflow, overlay edges, stacked overlays, hide stack order, and row extremes. Requires either a test TUI harness (if one doesn't exist) or direct use of the Renderer + Overlay integration — inspect tui_render_test.exs for the established pattern.
